BackstoryDef.title: nascent spirit
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} condensed out of drifting elemental essence, corrupted by mamono mana into a woman's form, and spent {PAWN_possessive} early days adrift on the currents of {PAWN_possessive} element, learning the shape of the world.

BackstoryDef.title: earth-tender gnome
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} grew into a quiet tender of the deep earth, tending veins of ore like roots in the soil, and searching the caves for a man to root herself to.

BackstoryDef.title: flame-keeper ignis
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} grew into a keeper of the open flame, stoking fires and tempers alike, and wandering the hot lands for a man to set alight.

BackstoryDef.title: sky-wandering sylph
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} grew into a wanderer of the high winds, collecting rumours of romance from every corner of the sky, and swooping down on a whim after any man who caught her fancy.

BackstoryDef.title: spring-keeper undine
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} grew into a keeper of lakes and springs, drawing a steady catch from the water and mending what the current brought her, dreaming of a man to devote herself to.

BackstoryDef.title: clay-shaper dorome
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} grew into a slow, contented shaper of wet earth, raising banks and bricks from the mud of caves and wetlands, and waiting patiently for a man to wrap in a warm, muddy embrace.

BackstoryDef.title: tree-warden dryad
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} grew into a warden of the deep forest, coaxing fruit and timber from the trees she calls her own, and luring the men who wander beneath her boughs into her warm, hollowed trunk.

BackstoryDef.title: love-dancer apsara
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} grew into a dancer of the love goddess, perfecting the "dance of love" that steals the heart of any who behold it, and wandering from river to sea to fill loveless men with love.

BackstoryDef.title: lamp-bound genie
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} was bound into a magic lamp and passed from hand to hand across the desert, studying each new owner's heart and crafting their dearest wishes into being - always in the letter, if not the spirit.
